Problem: How do you prevent a legacy monoliths domain model from polluting the domain model of a new service
Context: Integrating a new service (potentially a microservice) with an existing legacy monolith, where the legacy system has a distinct domain model that should not directly influence or corrupt the new service's domain model.
Solution: Define an anticorruption layer which translates between the two domain models
